RESOLUTION 2026-08-22 (see docs/research/requirement-conflicts/09-vu-law-in-society-deadlines.md): NOT A CONFLICT — and THE SOURCE HAS BEEN CORRECTED since the 2026-08-21 capture. Three deadlines, three applicant populations, all simultaneously true. SEPARATELY, and not part of this conflict: the ten monthly Admission Board rounds running to 1 June 2026 (VUA0019) are a DECISION-TIMING schedule, not a deadline, and the entrance-exam timing guidance (REQ-2026-08-21-VUA0031) is advisory, not a cut-off — neither belongs in the deadline comparison set.
